crossRefs.note: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.
translations.bsb: So Joshua did this and delivered them from the hands of the Israelites, and they did not kill the Gibeonites.
translations.kjv: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew
translations.asv: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
